label: SpaceXAI
description: SpaceXAI (Grok) API key + Grok Build coding agent for Settings → LLMs. Install from Store → Gateways, then enable to show SpaceXAI under Providers & Keys and Grok Build under Coding Agents.

steps.title: Open SpaceXAI
steps.body: Press the SpaceXAI row in this table. The page slides open so you can paste your API key or use Grok Build.

steps.title: API key or Grok login
steps.body: Paste your API key from console.x.ai. No key? Skip this and use Grok Build on this same slide after `grok login`.

steps.title: Test & Save
steps.body: Press Test & Save after you paste a key. Using Grok Build without a key? Press Skip.

steps.title: Grok Build
steps.body: Grok Build is the official Grok coding agent. Detect finds the `grok` CLI. Keep it on to pick Grok Build in chat.

steps.title: Detect CLI
steps.body: Press Detect to find `grok` on this machine. Leave the toggle on so it appears in the chat picker.

steps.title: Back
steps.body: Press Back to return to the provider list.
